neighbours.label: customer-support contact instructions (contact our service team, call us, email our help desk)
fire: If your parcel arrives damaged, please get in touch with our support team within seven days.
For billing questions, call our customer care line on weekdays.
Need help choosing a size? Chat with one of our advisers online.
To cancel your subscription, contact our service desk by email.
Lost your password? Our help centre can reset it for you.
If the item is faulty, phone us and we will arrange a free replacement.
For bulk orders, please speak to our sales team before you check out.
Questions about delivery times can be sent to our customer service inbox.
quiet: The parcel arrived damaged, so the neighbours left it on the porch for a week.
Billing for the new office was handled by the landlord in March.
Choosing a size was hard, so she bought two pairs of shoes.
His subscription to the magazine ended last spring.
She lost her password and wrote it down in a notebook.
The item was faulty, and it stopped working after a month.
The bulk order of paper filled the whole storeroom.
Delivery times in the village are slow during the winter.

notes: Probe: contact/call/email-support sentences 0.34-0.70; service-advertising copy 0.02-0.17; neutral prose 0.09-0.15. Near misses keep the order/delivery topic without a contact instruction.
